intro: From the ByWard Market to Elgin Street, Ottawa punches above its weight for dinner. These are the spots locals keep recommending.

picks.name: Beckta
picks.why: Ottawa's best-known fine-dining room, in a heritage mansion. Book ahead for celebrations.

picks.name: The Whalesbone
picks.why: Oysters and sustainable seafood in a small, buzzy room.

picks.name: Riviera
picks.why: Elegant dining room in a grand former bank building, with a polished seasonal menu.

picks.name: Kochin Kitchen
picks.why: South Indian Keralan cooking — coconut curries and appams you don't see everywhere.

picks.name: El Camino
picks.why: Inventive tacos and cocktails in a lively room. Great for a fun, casual night out.

picks.name: Ramen Isshin
picks.why: Rich bowls of ramen when the Ottawa winter bites.

picks.name: Fairouz Cafe
picks.why: Modern Middle Eastern sharing plates in a warm setting.

picks.name: Elgin Street Diner
picks.why: Classic diner open around the clock — the late-night poutine stop.
